| FIND-01 | medium | 'Tandai terlambat' on a DUE invoice with no past due date stores OVERDUE, but the chip immediately re-derives to Terkirim (deriveInvoiceDisplayStatus). | FIND-04 | medium | Blocked-popup detection never works: invoice detail (sendWhatsApp) and the Beranda queue (openReminder) call window.open(href, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') and treat a null return as 'blocked', but the HTML spec makes window.open() return null whenever noopener is set. So after WhatsApp opens normally, a 'Buka WhatsApp' fallback link still appears (a second click opens a second chat), and a really blocked popup is indistinguishable. | fixed: PR #29 (merge ac53043, into staging 2026-10-07; not yet on main/Production). Both surfaces now open a blank tab on the click (src/lib/whatsapp-popup.ts), cut its opener and navigate it without a Referer, so null from window.open means a real block. Regression: e2e/home/follow-up-queue.spec.ts and e2e/invoices/overdue-invoice.spec.ts (popup opened -> one tab, no fallback), e2e/whatsapp/popup-blocker.spec.ts (real Chromium blocker -> fallback, no tab). Real phones and the WhatsApp app stay MAN-WA-01 | HOME-03, INV-WA-02 |
| FIND-05 | medium | Beranda 'Kirim pengingat' always rotated the invoice's share token (POST /api/invoices/:id/share -> createOrRegenerateShare), while invoice detail reuses the active link. A link the brand already received returned 404 after a reminder from Beranda (verified 2026-10-04 with a session-less context). | fixed: PR #30 (merge e498ad5, into staging 2026-10-07; not yet on main/Production). Chris's decision 2026-10-07: a reminder reuses a usable active link and creates one only when none is usable; only explicit Regenerate rotates. Regression: e2e/invoices/reminder-share-link.spec.ts (reuse, repeat, no share, expired, Regenerate still rotates) and src/lib/invoice-share.test.ts. | HOME-03, SHARE-02 |

| FIND-07 | medium | Invoice detail treated an expired share as active: the share section read 'Tautan aktif sampai <past date>.' and Kirim lewat WhatsApp / Kirim pengingat sent that expired link, which shows the recipient 'Tautan ini sudah tidak berlaku.' Cause: getShareState reported any existing row as active, and sendWhatsApp reused the loaded link without checking expiry. Regression: e2e/invoices/expired-share.spec.ts, src/lib/invoice-share.test.ts, invoice-detail-client.test.tsx. | INV-STATUS-06, INV-WA-01, SHARE-01, SHARE-02 |

| FIND-09 | low | The invoice document (recipient page and both PDFs) prints 'Tanggal terbit' as the UTC calendar day of Invoice.createdAt (formatDateLong formats in UTC). Seen 2026-10-10 04:00 WIB while running the FIND-08 journey: an invoice created that morning printed '9 Oktober 2026'. Due dates are not affected (stored as UTC midnight of the calendar date). | open: not changed in the FIND-08 PR (out of its scope). Needs a product decision (print the Asia/Jakarta calendar day, or keep). No browser test asserts either behaviour. | PUB-01, INV-PDF-01 |
| FIND-10 | high | Any change to a deal that did not itself name a stage moved the deal back to Masuk and wrote a '<stage> → Masuk' entry into its history: saving the contact name on deal detail, and repairing the WhatsApp number on deal detail, on invoice detail (Simpan & kirim) or in the Beranda queue. Cause: dealPatchSchema was dealInputSchema.partial(), and zod's partial() keeps the create schema's status default ('MASUK'), so every PATCH /api/deals/:id without a status carried status MASUK. The page kept showing the old stage until its next load. Present since the M1 slice (65393b6, 2026-07-14), so it is on main/Production. Found 2026-10-11 by the first DEAL-DETAIL-02 journey (stage read after a reload on a Nego deal); the earlier unit test used a deal already at Masuk and the contact-repair journey did not read the stage. | fixed: fix/deal-patch-keeps-stage-2026-10-11 (into staging; not yet on main/Production). The patch schema now has no status default, so a patch changes only what it names. Regression: src/lib/deal-validation.test.ts, src/lib/deals.test.ts (every non-Masuk stage x four patch shapes), e2e/deals/patch-keeps-stage.spec.ts (contact name on a Nego deal; number repaired from invoice detail on an Invoice deal), e2e/deals/contact-repair.spec.ts (stage and history asserted). Stored rows are not repaired: deals already moved to Masuk this way stay there, and their history shows the '→ Masuk' entry at the time of the edit. A read-only Production count of such transitions needs Chris. | DEAL-DETAIL-02, DEAL-DETAIL-03 |
| FIND-11 | low | A saved contact name cannot be removed on deal detail. Emptying the field and pressing Simpan sends an empty PATCH body (contactName \|\| undefined), the page answers 'Nama kontak disimpan', and the old name is put back in the field and is still there after a reload. Verified in the browser 2026-10-11. | open: not changed (outside the FIND-10 fix). Needs a small decision: let an empty name clear it, or say that it cannot be cleared. No browser test asserts either behaviour. | DEAL-DETAIL-02 |

## Classification rules

- automated_real_interaction: a browser test reaches the action through the control a person sees (click, tap, keyboard, navigation) AND asserts the user-observable outcome; mutating actions must also assert persistence after reload/navigation.
- Playwright fill() into a plain visible text/tel/number/textarea field counts as real typing (fill() requires the element to be visible, enabled and editable, and focuses it). fill() does NOT count for native-picker controls (date, select, file) or any control whose visible affordance is a different element from the DOM control (e.g. the opacity-0 date input under the due-date display).
- automated_partial: the test uses page.goto to skip the in-app entry point, fill() on a picker control, page.request/API calls, page.evaluate fetch, stubs/mocks, component tests with fireEvent, or asserts only rendering (screenshots, axe scans, text presence).
- A test that is test.skip()-ed or test.fixme()-ed in a project does not count for that project; a test.fail()-annotated (expected-failure) test never counts as coverage. `npm run coverage:journeys` enforces this: every titled reference must be a test Playwright itself registers (`playwright test --list`), and each claimed project needs a real test that its AST shows is not skipped, fixme'd or expected to fail there; a condition it cannot evaluate does not count. With `--results <playwright-json>` it also checks the claims against an actual run: CI does this for the @critical run on every PR, and the separate `Journey coverage (full)` workflow does it for every real claim (`--require-results`).
- tests/ux-audit specs run in the CI ux-audit job, which is report-gated (scripts/ux-audit.ts), not a per-test exit-code gate; they are credited but called out as such.
- A P0/P1 action that is not `automated_real_interaction` or `manual_verified`, or that still carries a manual check, must have an entry in the exception register (`exceptions` in the inventory): its category, why it is not fully automated, whether it blocks a release, the evidence a release needs, and whether an automation strategy exists. `npm run coverage:journeys` fails when an entry is missing, stale, or contradicts the action's status.
